name: overcite-vscode
description: Search literature sources from LaTeX citation commands and insert BibTeX into VS Code workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: OverCite supports virtual LaTeX workspaces, including projects opened through Overleaf Workshop.

overcite.adsApiToken.markdownDescription: ADS/SciX API token used for search and BibTeX export. Required by the Astronomy / Astrophysics preset and optional for Physics, which can fall back to Crossref and arXiv. Get a token from [NASA ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/user/settings/token) or [SciX](https://scixplorer.org/user/settings/token).

enumDescriptions: General preset using Crossref, with DataCite for dataset DOIs.
Physics preset using ADS/SciX first when configured, then Crossref and arXiv if needed.
Computer science preset using Crossref first, then arXiv if needed.
Math preset using Crossref first, then arXiv if needed.
Biology / medicine preset using Crossref first, then PubMed if needed.
Chemistry preset using Crossref / DOI only.
Astronomy / astrophysics preset using ADS/SciX only.
overcite.sourceProfile.markdownDescription: Choose a subject-area preset. Each preset uses one fast default source; add fallbacks only for cross-field work.

overcite.primarySource.markdownDescription: Primary source searched first when `overcite.sourceProfile` is `custom`.

overcite.fallbackSources.markdownDescription: Fallback sources searched when the primary source does not produce a strong match. Used when `overcite.sourceProfile` is `custom`. 1 database is usually enough. Add 1-2 backups only for cross-field work.

overcite.ncbiApiKey.markdownDescription: Optional NCBI API key for higher-rate PubMed requests in Biology / Medicine. PubMed still works without one. See the [official NCBI API-key instructions](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK53593/).

overcite.citationKeyMode.markdownDescription: Use a plain author-year key like `Shariat2025`, an underscore key like `Shariat_2025`, a colon key like `Shariat:2025`, an informative key like `Shariat25_10k`, an ADS bibcode like `2025PASP..137i4201S`, or preserve the typed key when possible.

overcite.bibliographyInsertMode.markdownDescription: Insert new BibTeX entries alphabetically by final citation key (default), or append them at the end of the target `.bib` file.

overcite.defaultSearchMode.markdownDescription: Choose whether `OverCite: Resolve Citation` starts in contextual mode, simple search mode, or raw query mode. The separate simple-search and raw-query commands are still always available.

overcite.contextualSearchEngine.markdownDescription: Context Beta is experimental: common author-year names and ambiguous prose can return incorrect or missing papers. Review suggestions before insertion. Simple search and raw query are unchanged.

overcite.projectBibFileOverrides.markdownDescription: Optional object keyed by workspace folder path (or folder URI for a virtual workspace). Values should be `.bib` filenames to force OverCite to use in that workspace.
